<function name="SetRenderBoundsWS" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the render bounds for the entity in world space coordinates. For relative coordinates see <page>Entity:SetRenderBounds</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="mins" type="Vector">The minimum corner of the bounds, relative to origin of the world/map.</arg>
		<arg name="maxs" type="Vector">The maximum corner of the bounds, relative to origin of the world/map.</arg>
		<arg name="add" type="Vector" default="Vector( 0, 0, 0 )">If defined, adds this vector to maxs and subtracts this vector from mins.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
